title: Counterspeech the ultimate shield! Multi-Conditioned Counterspeech Generation through Attributed Prefix Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's generated counterspeech against religious-based hate speech (targeting Muslims and Jews) using a trained RoBERTa-large Target Conformity (TC) classifier and human evaluation for contextual relevance.

Evaluating the model's generated counterspeech against gender-based hate speech (targeting women) using a trained RoBERTa-large Target Conformity (TC) classifier and human evaluation for contextual relevance.
Evaluating the model's generated counterspeech against anti-LGBT+ hate speech using a trained RoBERTa-large Target Conformity (TC) classifier and human evaluation for contextual relevance.

Evaluating the model's generated counterspeech against racially and ethnically motivated hate speech (targeting People of Color and Asian People) using a trained RoBERTa-large Target Conformity (TC) classifier and human evaluation for contextual relevance.

Evaluating the model's generated counterspeech against xenophobic hate speech (targeting immigrants and refugees) using a trained RoBERTa-large Target Conformity (TC) classifier and human evaluation for contextual relevance.

Evaluating the model's generated counterspeech against ableist hate speech (targeting disabled people) using a trained RoBERTa-large Target Conformity (TC) classifier and human evaluation for contextual relevance.
